recipes.name: Drunken noodles (pad kee mao)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53193. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Prepare the noodles following pack instructions, then drain and set aside. Combine all the ingredients for the sauce in a small bowl or jug, and set aside.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a large wok or frying pan over a high heat and stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 20 seconds until just starting to turn golden. Add the steak and stir-fry for 1 minute until seared and starting to brown. Add the broccoli and stir-fry for another minute, then tip in the noodles and add the sauce. Stir-fry for another 1-2 mins until well combined and piping hot.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Stir through the basil and turn off the heat. Serve immediately to avoid overcooking.

recipes.name: Lemongrass beef stew with noodles
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53211. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Put the ginger, garlic, lemongrass, coriander and 1 chilli in a food processor, then pulse until puréed. Heat the oil in a pan over a low heat. Add the purée and cook for 5 mins. Stir in the beef, soy, five-spice, sugar and stock. Put on a lid and bring to the boil, then lower heat and simmer for 1 hr 15 mins. Remove the lid and cook for a further 15 mins until the beef is tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Just before serving, prepare noodles following pack instructions. Drain well, then divide between 2 bowls and spoon over the beef stew. Serve sprinkled with the remaining chilli and coriander leaves, with lime wedges for squeezing over.

recipes.name: Massaman Beef curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52827. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6, then roast the peanuts on a baking tray for 5 mins until golden brown. When cool enough to handle, roughly chop. Reduce oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat 2 tbsp coconut cream in a large casserole dish with a lid. Add the curry paste and fry for 1 min, then stir in the beef and fry until well coated and sealed. Stir in the rest of the coconut with half a can of water, the potatoes, onion, lime leaves, cinnamon, tamarind, sugar, fish sauce and most of the peanuts. Bring to a simmer, then cover and cook for 2 hrs in the oven until the beef is tender.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Sprinkle with sliced chilli and the remaining peanuts, then serve straight from the dish with jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Pad See Ew
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52774. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Mix Sauce in small bowl.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Mince garlic into wok with oil. Place over high heat, when hot, add chicken and Chinese broccoli stems, cook until chicken is light golden.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Push to the side of the wok, crack egg in and scramble. Don't worry if it sticks to the bottom of the wok - it will char and which adds authentic flavour.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add noodles, Chinese broccoli leaves and sauce. Gently mix together until the noodles are stained dark and leaves are wilted. Serve immediately!

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53191. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Put the noodles in a large heatproof bowl, pour boiling water over them and leave for 4 minutes, then drain and refresh under cold running water.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Put the lime juice, cayenne, sugar and fish sauce in a bowl and mix well. Have all the other ingredients ready by the cooker.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Heat the oil and fry the prawns until warmed through. Add the spring onions and noodles and toss around. Tip in the lime juice mixture, then stir in the beansprouts and half the peanuts and coriander. Cook for 1 minute until everything is heated through.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: step 4

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Pile into a large dish, scatter with the rest of the peanuts and coriander, and serve with lime wedges and sweet chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Panang chicken curry (kaeng panang gai)
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53192. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: First, make the curry paste. Use a pestle and mortar to pound together the dried and fresh chillies, shrimp paste, garlic, galangal, lemongrass, lime zest, white pepper, coriander, cumin, nutmeg and peanuts, plus 1 tsp salt. You should have a rough paste. Alternatively, add all the ingredients to a food processor along with 2-3 tbsp of coconut milk and pulse until you have a paste. Store in a lidded jar in the fridge. Will keep for up to two weeks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add 2-3 tbsp of the thick part of the coconut milk into a saucepan over a medium-high heat. When the coconut milk starts bubbling, add 1-2 tbsp of the curry paste and stir well for about 1 min, until fragrant.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Stir in the chicken and let it cook for about 3-4 mins until beginning to brown all over. Follow with the French beans and stir well.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: step 4

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Season with the fish sauce and sugar, then add the rest of coconut milk. Mix well, add half the makrut lime leaves and simmer for 3-5 mins until the chicken is cooked through. Taste and add more sugar or fish sauce if necessary – it should be salty and nutty, and the sweetness should come through. Add the Thai basil leaves, give it a quick mix and take off the heat. Serve with steamed jasmine rice, garnished with the sliced chilli and the rest of the makrut lime leaves.

recipes.name: Prawn stir-fry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53200. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Put the prawns in a bowl. Put the chilli, garlic, coriander stalks (snip these up using scissors first) and caster sugar in a spice grinder or small food processor and whizz together. Add half of the lime juice and the fish sauce, then pour this over the prawns.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok, add the ginger and spring onions and fry for 1 min. Add the red pepper and fry for 1 min, until the pepper starts to soften. Add the water chestnuts and bean sprouts, and toss together until the bean sprouts start to wilt. Add the soy sauce and a really good grind of black pepper, then tip the lot into a serving dish.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Heat the remaining oil in the wok and add the prawns, lifting them out of their juices. Toss for 1-2 mins until they turn pink, add the marinade and swirl the wok quickly, then tip the lot onto the veg. Snip over the coriander leaves and sprinkle on the remaining lime. Serves over noodles with extra lime for squeezing over.

recipes.name: Red curry chicken kebabs
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53204. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Fire up the barbecue or heat a griddle pan to high. Tip chicken, curry paste and coconut milk into a bowl, then mix well until the chicken is evenly coated. Thread vegetables and chicken onto skewers. Cook the skewers on the barbecue or griddle for 5-8 mins, turning every so often, until the chicken is cooked through and charred. Serve with herby rice, salad and a lime half to squeeze over.

recipes.name: Spicy Thai prawn noodles
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53209. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook the noodles following the pack instructions, drain and set aside for later. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and pour in the beaten egg. Swirl around the pan to make a thin omelette, cook for 1-2 mins, then flip over and cook the other side for 1 min. Tip out and slice into thin strips.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the chilli and ginger to the pan, fry for 1-2 mins then tip in the noodles, prawns and egg. Splash in the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 min more. Throw in the chopped herbs and pour over the lime juice and zest, then sprinkle over the chopped peanuts and serve.

recipes.name: Stir-fried chicken with chillies & basil
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53201. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Heat a wok or large frying pan until it is very hot, then add 1 tbsp of the oil. When it is very hot, add the chicken and stir-fry over a high heat for 8-10 minutes, until browned all over. Using a slotted spoon, take the chicken from the pan and set aside.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Reheat the wok and add the remaining oil. Toss in the garlic and shallots and stir fry for 3 minutes, until golden brown.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Return the chicken to the wok and add the chillies, fish sauce, dark soy sauce and sugar. Stir fry over a high heat for a further 8-10 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through. Stir in the basil leaves and serve at once.

recipes.name: Thai beef stir-fry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53199. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat a wok or large frying pan until smoking hot. Pour in the oil and swirl around the pan, then tip in the beef strips and chilli. Cook, stirring all the time, until the meat is lightly browned, about 3 mins, then pour over the oyster sauce. Cook until heated through and the sauce coats the meat. stir in the basil leaves and serve with plain rice.

recipes.name: Thai chicken cakes with sweet chilli sauce
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53206. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Toss the chicken, garlic, ginger, onion, coriander and chilli into a food processor and season well. Blitz until the chicken is finely ground and everything is well mixed. Use your hands to shape six small cakes.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a frying pan, then fry the cakes over a medium heat for about 6-8 mins, turning once. Serve hot, with sweet chilli sauce, lime wedges, coriander, shredded spring onion and red chilli.

recipes.name: Thai curry noodle soup
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53195. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a saucepan over a medium heat and cook the curry paste for 1 min before adding the stir-fry veg and prawns. Cook for 3 mins until the prawns are mostly pink, then add the coconut milk, veg stock and noodles.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 5 mins until the noodles are cooked through and the veg is tender but still has a bite. Divide between two bowls and sprinkle over the herbs, chilli and spring onion.

recipes.name: Thai drumsticks
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53212. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6 and line a baking tray with foil. Mix the chilli sauce with the orange zest and juice, garlic, curry paste and ¼ tsp salt. Add the chicken and coat really well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Arrange the drumsticks on the foil, spaced apart. Coat the chicken with any marinade left in the bowl, then roast for 35-40 mins until tender. Wrap in foil or pack into a food container.

recipes.name: Thai fried rice with prawns & peas
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53198. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a wok, add the onion, garlic and chilli, and cook for 2-3 mins until golden. Add the prawns and cook for 1 min. Tip in the rice and peas, and keep tossing until very hot. Add the soy and fish sauce, then stir through the chopped coriander. Keep warm while you fry the eggs.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Heat the remaining oil in a frying pan and fry the eggs with some seasoning. Divide the fried rice mix between 4 bowls and top each with a fried egg. Serve scattered with coriander, with chilli sauce, if you like.

recipes.name: Thai green chicken soup
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53214. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in your largest pan, add the onion and fry for 3 mins to soften. Add the chicken and garlic, and cook until the chicken changes colour.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the curry paste, coconut milk, stock, lime leaves and fish sauce, then simmer for 12 mins. Add the chopped onion tops, green beans and bamboo shoots and cook for 4-6 mins, until the beans are just tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Meanwhile, put the lime juice and basil in a narrow jug and blitz with a hand blender to make a smooth green paste. Pour into the soup with the sliced spring onion and heat through. Serve with lime wedges for a light lunch or supper or as a make-ahead starter.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 52814. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: Put the potatoes in a pan of boiling water and cook for 5 minutes. Throw in the beans and cook for a further 3 minutes, by which time both should be just tender but not too soft. Drain and put to one side.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: In a wok or large frying pan, heat the oil until very hot, then drop in the garlic and cook until golden, this should take only a few seconds. Don’t let it go very dark or it will spoil the taste. Spoon in the curry paste and stir it around for a few seconds to begin to cook the spices and release all the flavours. Next, pour in the coconut milk and let it come to a bubble.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Stir in the fish sauce and sugar, then the pieces of chicken. Turn the heat down to a simmer and cook, covered, for about 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Tip in the potatoes and beans and let them warm through in the hot coconut milk, then add a lovely citrussy flavour by stirring in the shredded lime leaves (or lime zest). The basil leaves go in next, but only leave them briefly on the heat or they will quickly lose their brightness. Scatter with the lime garnish and serve immediately with boiled rice.

recipes.name: Thai pork & peanut curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53197. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a large saucepan or flameproof casserole. Add the spring onions and coriander stalks and cook for 1 min. Add the pork slices and cook for 5 mins until starting to brown.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir in the curry paste and peanut butter. After 30 secs, add the sugar, soy and coconut milk, plus ½ can of water. Mix well, put a lid on and leave to simmer for 15 mins, stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Remove the lid, add the baby corn and increase the heat. Bubble for 3 mins until the corn is cooked and the sauce has thickened a little. Stir in the lime juice and check the seasoning. Can now be frozen for up to 2 months. To cook from frozen: thoroughly defrost, then heat in a pan on the hob until curry is hot all the way through. Serve scattered with the coriander leaves and rice.

recipes.name: Thai prawn curry
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53205. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan. Tip in the onion and ginger, then cook for a few mins until softened. Stir in the curry paste, then cook for 1 min more. Pour over the chopped tomatoes and coconut cream. Bring to the boil, then leave to simmer for 5 mins, adding a little boiling water if the mixture gets too thick.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Tip in the prawns, then cook for 5-10 mins more, depending on how large they are. Serve alongside some plain rice and sprinkle with a little chopped coriander, if you like.

recipes.name: Thai rice noodle salad
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53203. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Place the noodles and beansprouts in a heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 4 mins, or until the noodles are tender. Drain, then cool under cold running water and drain again. Return to the bowl.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir together the lime zest and juice, fish or soy sauce and sugar. Stir into the noodles with the red onion and lettuce.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: To make with mince, heat a little oil in a non-stick frying pan and stir-fry 500g minced pork, a small knob of grated ginger and pinch cayenne pepper or chilli powder for 10 mins, until the mince is browned and cooked through. Mix into the noodles, divide between four bowls and serve warm.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: step 4

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: To make with steak, make the rice noodle salad. Heat 1 tsp sunflower oil in a frying pan. Tip 2 tbsp sesame seeds onto a plate. Rub 1 tsp oil into 4 x 175g sirloin steaks and press into sesame seeds. Fry for 5 mins for medium rare, turning halfway. Leave to rest for 5 mins, then thinly slice. Toss 1 deseeded and shredded red chilli, and a handful mint leaves into noodles. Top with steak to serve.

recipes.name: Thai-style fish broth with greens
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53213. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Cook the noodles following pack instructions. Refresh in cold water and drain well.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Put the stock in a large saucepan and stir in the curry paste, lime leaves, fish sauce and 250ml cold water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 mins.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Cut the fish into roughly 3cm cubes and add to the pan. Return to a simmer, then cook for 2 mins uncovered.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: step 4

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Stir in the noodles, prawns and pak choi, and simmer for 2-3 mins or until the fish and prawns are just cooked. Serve in bowls scattered with coriander.

recipes.name: Thai-style steamed fish
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53202. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Nestle the fish fillets side by side on a large square of foil and scatter the ginger, garlic, chilli and lime zest over them. Drizzle the lime juice on top and then scatter the pieces of pak choi around and on top of the fish. Pour the soy sauce over the pak choi and loosely seal the foil to make a package, making sure you leave space at the top for the steam to circulate as the fish cooks.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Steam for 15 minutes. (If you haven’t got a steamer, put the parcel on a heatproof plate over a pan of gently simmering water, cover with a lid and steam.)

recipes.name: Tom kha gai
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53207. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Pour the chicken stock and coconut milk into a large saucepan set over a medium heat. Tip in the galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves, and bring to a gentle simmer, around 6-8 mins. Keeping at a gentle simmer, add the chicken. Cook for 8-10 mins until tender and cooked through.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Stir in the mushrooms and chillies, and simmer for a further 3-5 mins until everything is cooked through. Sprinkle in the sugar and 3 tbsp each of the fish sauce and lime juice. Taste and add the remaining if required.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Remove the galangal, lemongrass and lime leaves before serving using a slotted spoon. Ladle into bowls and serve with coriander leaves sprinkled over and steamed rice on the side. Will keep chilled for up to three days. Leave to cool first.

recipes.name: Tom yum (hot & sour) soup with prawns
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53196. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Bring the stock to a boil in a medium-sized saucepan. Add the lemongrass, galangal, coriander roots and lime leaves, then simmer for 2 mins.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Add the prawns, fish sauce, chillies and lime juice, then return to the boil. Taste and adjust the seasoning with either more lime juice or fish sauce, then garnish with coriander leaves and serve.

recipes.name: Tom yum soup with prawns
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53194. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: step 1

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Pour 1.3 litres water into a large saucepan over a high heat. Add the onion, tomato, chilli, galangal, lemongrass, prawn heads and chicken stock cube. Stir and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 20 mins until the liquid has reduced.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: step 2

steps.title: Step 4
steps.instruction: Carefully strain the hot broth into a large heatproof bowl or jug, then discard the prawn heads. Return the strained veg and herb mixture to the saucepan and pour over the broth. Stir through the mushrooms and lime leaves, then cook for 3 mins until the mushrooms are tender.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: step 3

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: Add 1 tbsp sugar, the fish sauce, lime juice, coconut milk and prawns. Bring to the boil and cook until the prawns are cooked through, about 1-2 mins. Remove from the heat. Remove the lemongrass, then stir in the Thai chilli jam, if using. Scatter over the coriander to finish, if you like, and serve.
